lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's fifty-four? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 54? Nope!

lines.text: Top six, bottom ten, and the top triangle is nine. What's the whole area?
lines.caption: Top 6, bottom 10, and the top triangle is 9. What's the whole area?

lines.text: The bottom triangle is a copy of the top one. Six to ten is three to five.
lines.caption: The bottom triangle is a copy of the top one. 6 to 10 is 3 to 5.

lines.text: The base grows by five over three, and so does the height. So nine becomes twenty-five!
lines.caption: The base grows by 5/3, and so does the height. So 9 becomes 25!

lines.text: The side triangles share the top one's height. Nine times five over three: fifteen each.
lines.caption: The side triangles share the top one's height. 9 × 5/3: 15 each.

lines.text: Nine plus twenty-five plus fifteen plus fifteen is sixty-four!
lines.caption: 9 plus 25 plus 15 plus 15 is 64!

lines.text: Fifty-four was the trap. It grows the area only once.
lines.caption: 54 was the trap. It grows the area only once.

lines.text: Did you get sixty-four? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 64? Tell me below!
